transformationRules.label: Leveling / detail loss
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Compression toward fewer remembered distinctions

transformationRules.label: Sharpening / salience amplification
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Selective amplification of memorable or emotionally salient elements

transformationRules.label: Assimilation to prior schema
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Reframing unfamiliar material through existing cultural categories

transformationRules.label: Causal rationalization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Insert or regularize causal explanation where memory/interpretation leaves gaps

transformationRules.label: Selective omission
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Remove elements with low mnemonic/social support

transformationRules.label: Allomotif substitution
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Replace a structural realization while preserving the motifeme role

transformationRules.label: Localization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Attach transmitted material to local places, persons, institutions, or ritual categories

transformationRules.label: Performance-keying transformation
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Change style/selection according to performer, audience, occasion, and genre key

transformationRules.label: Formulaic recomposition
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Recompose narrative using remembered formulas and thematic slots rather than verbatim copying

transformationRules.label: Canonical fixation
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Institutional/written fixation lowers some forms of variation while preserving editorial mediation

transformationRules.label: Media remediation
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Change mnemonic and distribution properties when lore moves between media

transformationRules.label: Prestige-biased substitution
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Prefer variants associated with prestigious transmitters

transformationRules.label: Conformist regularization
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Pull variants toward locally frequent forms

transformationRules.label: Content-biased attraction
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Prefer variants with content properties that increase attention/retention

transformationRules.label: Guided innovation
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Introduce novel variants through reconstruction, learning, or problem-solving

transformationRules.label: Unbiased drift
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Random frequency change without directional preference

transformationRules.label: Lineage branching
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Create descendant variants that diverge under partially separated transmission

transformationRules.label: Lineage blending / recombination
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Combine elements from previously distinct variant lineages

transformationRules.label: Complex-contagion gating
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Delay adoption until social reinforcement passes a threshold

transformationRules.label: Source-critical differentiation
transformationRules.semanticEffect: Preserve distinctions between testimony, performance, remembered information, and later record

theoryManifest.design: Mechanism-level priors. These parameters are explicitly defeasible and must remain separate from world truth.
